title: Eurobot 2025/26: the robot rules a design can be checked against

source.where: F.3 Dimensions, p. 10: 'The perimeter of a robot must not exceed 1200 mm at the departure time' (the convex shell of its vertical projection)
F.3 Dimensions, p. 10: 'The perimeter of the fully deployed robot must not exceed 1400 mm during the match'
F.3 Dimensions, p. 10: 'the height of each robot and manipulated object must not exceed 350 mm' (excludes the beacon support mast)
F.3 Dimensions, p. 10: 'it can be tolerated that the emergency stop button exceeds this height limit to reach 375 mm'
F.4.c Emergency stop button, p. 11: 'The button may exceed the system's height by 25 mm'
F.4.c Emergency stop button, p. 11: 'have at least a diameter of 20 mm'
F.4.c Emergency stop button, p. 11: 'All robots have to be equipped with a red emergency stop button'
F.4.b Energy sources, p. 11: 'the on-board voltages must not exceed 48 V DC'
F.6 Other design constraints, p. 13: 'triggered by pulling the end of a cord at least 500 mm long'
H.2 The match / H.3 End of match, p. 20: 'it has 100 secondes'; 'At the end of the 100 seconds, the robots must stop and turn off all their actuators'
F.6 Other design constraints, p. 14: 'All teams are required to equip its robot with a system for detecting opposing team's robots'

notChecked.rule: F.6 beacon support: flat, opaque, 430 ± 5 mm up, within a 200 mm circle around the centre, 70 mm circle to 100 mm square, Velcro on top, holds 400 g
notChecked.why: the mechanics have no mast yet

notChecked.rule: F.6 visibility: a 100 × 70 mm flat space on a side face for the organisers' sticker
notChecked.why: the chassis has no side faces modelled
the design has no deployable mechanism (the team adds it)

notChecked.rule: F.4.b lithium batteries: a manufacturer BMS and solid case, or LiFePO4, or a fireproof bag and a homologated charger
notChecked.why: the battery catalog does not record BMS or case yet
